title_en: From a Scratch to a World Without Smallpox
title_zh: 从一道划痕到天花绝迹
english_paragraphs: Smallpox, a contagious affliction, killed about three in ten of its sufferers and an estimated 300 million in the 20th century. An early safeguard, deliberately implanting matter from its sores in the healthy, was practised in China by the 16th century and reached England in 1721. The procedure itself could cause grave sickness or death, if less frequently than natural smallpox.

Rustic lore held that milkmaids with cowpox, a mild ailment of livestock, were immune to smallpox. In 1774 Benjamin Jesty, a Dorset farmer, employed cowpox to protect his wife and two sons. On 14 May 1796 Edward Jenner, a provincial practitioner, inserted fluid from a milkmaid's cowpox sore into a scratch on eight-year-old James Phipps.

On 1 July 1796 Jenner exposed the boy to smallpox; no symptoms ensued. In 1797 the Royal Society declined to publish his paper, judging his evidence unconvincing. In June 1798 he privately funded his book, the Inquiry, with supplementary cases. The word vaccine derives from the Latin vacca, cow.

Jenner was not the idea's originator. His contribution was a test, with results accessible in print, so other doctors could replicate and disseminate the technique. By today's standards, experimentation on a child without informed consent would be unethical. Jenner died on 26 January 1823, with smallpox far from eliminated.

In 1967 the WHO launched an intensified, concerted campaign to eradicate smallpox. The last naturally occurring case was diagnosed in Somalia on 26 October 1977. On 8 May 1980 the World Health Assembly formally declared the world free of smallpox, the only human disease ever wiped out. That pronouncement came almost 184 years after Phipps was vaccinated.
chinese_paragraphs: 天花是一种传染病，约有三成患者因此死亡；仅在20世纪，估计就夺走了3亿人的生命。一种早期预防办法，是把取自天花疮疹的物质接种给健康人。这种做法到16世纪已在中国使用，1721年传到英国。接种本身也可能造成重病或死亡，只是比自然感染天花时少见。
乡间相传，挤奶女工得过牛痘后，就会对天花免疫；牛痘是牲畜的一种轻微疾病。1774年，多塞特郡农夫本杰明·杰斯蒂就曾用牛痘来保护妻子和两个儿子。1796年5月14日，乡村医生爱德华·詹纳把取自一名挤奶女工牛痘疮的液体，接种到8岁男孩詹姆斯·菲普斯身上的一道划痕中。
1796年7月1日，詹纳让男孩接触天花，男孩没有出现症状。1797年，皇家学会认为证据缺乏说服力，拒绝发表他的论文。1798年6月，他自费出版《探究》，补充了更多病例。英语中表示疫苗的vaccine一词，来自拉丁语vacca，意思是牛。
詹纳不是这个想法的首创者。他的贡献在于开展试验，并把结果公开出版，让其他医生能够重复验证、传播这项技术。按今天的标准，在没有知情同意的情况下拿孩子做实验，是不合伦理的。詹纳于1823年1月26日去世，那时天花还远未被消除。
1967年，世界卫生组织发起更强有力的协同行动，决心根除天花。最后一例自然发生的天花病例，于1977年10月26日在索马里确诊。1980年5月8日，世界卫生大会正式宣布全球摆脱天花；它也是迄今唯一被彻底根除的人类疾病。此时，距菲普斯接种已过去近184年。

illustration_prompt:
Create a single publication-quality landscape 3:2 narrative illustration for an adult illustrated English-reading booklet. Finished standalone artwork, not a book mockup, not a collage of multiple unrelated panels. Sophisticated contemporary editorial gouache and watercolor, carefully controlled colored-pencil accents, velvety matte paint, subtle warm paper texture, soft natural daylight. Warm ivory paper dominates; subdued eucalyptus and sage greens structure the composition; restrained buttery lemon-yellow and dusty terracotta accents. Calm, comfortable, refined, credible drawing and natural anatomy. An airy coherent composition with one clear story focal point and at most two supporting details, generous breathing room at all edges and softly feathered painted edges into ivory. Detailed but uncluttered. Historically and scientifically appropriate objects, clothing and setting. Show the particular article's pivotal event or mechanism rather than a generic portrait or generic textbook symbols. Human figures treated with dignity; no grotesque caricature, no sensational violence or visible injuries. For disasters, emphasize the setting, evidence or human response without graphic suffering. For uncertain scientific claims, depict the observations and investigation without presenting debated mechanisms as proven. Absolutely no typography, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, diagram labels, fake writing or invented charts anywhere. Do not render invisible forces as literal magic. Avoid corporate vector icons, slick 3D rendering and childish cartoon style. High-quality, print-ready visual storytelling, matching a warm ivory-and-sage adult watercolor booklet.

ARTICLE-SPECIFIC SCENE:
A quiet, respectful historical scene in rural England in 1796, evoking Jenner preparing his cowpox test with eight-year-old James Phipps. A middle-aged Georgian physician in a simple waistcoat sits beside a child of about eight in plain period clothing, examining the boy's gently extended forearm; both figures have natural anatomy and neutral, dignified expressions. A tiny unlabeled glass dish and a closed period lancet lying on the table indicate the historical inoculation method, but show NO puncture, wound, rash, blood or visible injury. Absolutely NO hypodermic syringe, modern vaccination gun, disposable gloves or modern medical uniform. A single cow softly visible outside a small cottage window connects cowpox with the article's central idea. Do not depict a cheering heroic experiment, a consenting parent that the text does not establish, or a magically protected child. Soft ivory and sage, restrained terracotta clothing, adult narrative watercolor, no lettering or labels.
approved_summary: 天花约致三成患者死亡；早期人痘术把天花疮中物质接种给健康人作预防，风险虽低于自然染病，仍可能致重病或死亡。
乡间传牛痘可防天花；农夫杰斯蒂1774年已用牛痘保护家人，詹纳并非首创。
詹纳1796年给男孩种牛痘，再让他接触天花而未发病；无知情同意的儿童试验按今天标准不合伦理。
皇家学会嫌证据不足拒稿后，詹纳自费公布试验和补充病例，使其他医生能够重复验证、传播技术。
世卫1967年强化行动，1977年出现最后自然病例；1980年世界卫生大会宣布根除天花，迄今唯一被根除的人类疾病。
